records.jp: ……愛央が、読んでる本。<CR>きららにも教えてほしい
records.en_original: Ao. What kinds of books do you like?
records.en: ...Ao. Tell Kirara about the book you're reading.

records.jp: えーと、私のおすすめはねー……
records.en_original: Looking for a recommendation, huh?
records.en: Looking for a recommendation, huh?

records.jp: 高校生の女の子たちが異世界で戦う<CR>ファンタジー小説だよ
records.en_original: There's this fantasy novel I like where a bunch of girls get transported to another world and fight bad guys.
records.en: There's this fantasy novel I like where a bunch of girls get transported to another world and fight bad guys.

records.jp: ふむ。<CR>まるで、きららたちみたいだ
records.en_original: Hm. Sounds just like us.
records.en: Hm. Sounds just like Kirara and the others.

records.jp: でしょ！　私も、そう思って読み始めたんたけど<CR>結構面白いよ！
records.en_original: Right? I picked it up after noticing that and got pretty hooked.
records.en: Right? I picked it up after noticing that and got pretty hooked.

records.jp: きららみたいな、キャラクターはいるのか？
records.en_original: Are any of the characters like me?
records.en: Are there any characters like Kirara?

records.jp: ん～……詩帆さんとか、こころみたいな子はいたけど<CR>きららはいなかったかな
records.en_original: Hmm... There are two girls that are like Shiho and Kokoro, but no one quite like you, Kirara.
records.en: Hmm... There are two girls that are like Shiho-san and Kokoro, but no one quite like you, Kirara.

records.jp: やはり、きららは唯一無二の存在ということか
records.en_original: I suppose I am one of a kind, after all.
records.en: Kirara supposes she truly is one of a kind.

records.jp: イケメンの先生と女子高生の中身が<CR>入れ替わっちゃう、恋愛小説だよ
records.en_original: There's this romance novel I like where a super hot professor and one of his female students swap bodies.
records.en: There's this romance novel I like where a super hot professor and one of his female students swap bodies.

records.jp: ……入れ替わりで、恋愛小説？
records.en_original: They swap bodies? You said it's a romance novel, right?
records.en: They swap bodies? You said it's a romance novel, right?

records.jp: 現実にはあり得ないだろうけど、<CR>ちょっと面白そうだよねー
records.en_original: It's not exactly realistic, but it was a fun read.
records.en: It's not exactly realistic, but it was a fun read.

records.jp: きらら、こころと入れ替わってみたい
records.en_original: I would like to swap bodies with Kokoro.
records.en: Kirara would like to swap bodies with Kokoro.

records.jp: こころ？　なんで？
records.en_original: Huh? Why Kokoro?
records.en: Huh? Why Kokoro?

records.jp: きららには、無いものがあるから。<CR>人生で一度ぐらいは、あの重さを感じてみたい
records.en_original: Because she has what I do not. For once in my life, I would like to feel their...weight upon me.
records.en: Because Kokoro has something Kirara doesn't. Just once in her life, Kirara would like to feel that weight.

records.en_original: (What is she talking about...?)
records.en: (What is she talking about...?)

records.jp: そういうきららは、どういう本が好きなの？
records.en_original: What about you, Kirara?
records.en: What about you, Kirara?

records.jp: きららは……「トーテムポールの歴史」に<CR>「絶対に笑えるアメリカンジョーク」……
records.en_original: Me? I enjoy A Comprehensive History of Totem Poles, The Great Big Book of Dumb Puns...
records.en: Kirara likes... A Comprehensive History of Totem Poles and The Great Big Book of Dumb Puns...

records.jp: 「タニシの飼い方」に「絶対領域１００選」……<CR>それから「昼下がりの人妻」だな
records.en_original: Anyone Can Raise River Snails: A Guide, Long Socks and Short Skirts: 100 Candid Snaps, and Warm Afternoons and Married Women.
records.en: Anyone Can Raise River Snails: A Guide, Long Socks and Short Skirts: 100 Candid Snaps, and Warm Afternoons and Married Women.

records.jp: （相変わらずの、雑食っぷり……）
records.en_original: (Her tastes are as unique as always...)
records.en: (Her tastes are as unique as always...)

records.jp: どれか気になるタイトルはあった？
records.en_original: Did any pique your interest?
records.en: Did any pique your interest?

records.jp: アメリカンジョーク……かな？<CR>きらら、そう言うのも読むんだね
records.en_original: The Great Big Book of Dumb Puns, I guess? I didn't realize you were into that kind of thing.
records.en: The Great Big Book of Dumb Puns, I guess? I didn't realize you were into that kind of thing.

records.jp: いくつかとっておきのジョークを身につけた。<CR>笑いが必要な時には呼ぶといい
records.en_original: Thanks to it, I have a number of excellent jokes in my repertoire, so let me know if you ever need a laugh.
records.en: Thanks to it, I have a number of excellent jokes in my repertoire, so let me know if you ever need a laugh.

records.jp: （滑る予感しかしないんだよなあ……）
records.en_original: (She sounds awfully confident, but I'm not so sure...)
records.en: (She sounds awfully confident, but I'm not so sure...)

records.jp: 昼下がりの人妻……かな？<CR>それって、もしかして……
records.en_original: Warm Afternoons and Married Women, I guess? W-wait is that—
records.en: Warm Afternoons and Married Women, I guess? W-wait is that—

records.jp: うん。主婦の浮気を描いた作品
records.en_original: Yup. It's a work that depicts the affairs of housewives.
records.en: Yup. It's a work that depicts the affairs of housewives.

records.jp: ですよねー。<CR>その本、面白いの？
records.en_original: I knew it... Is it interesting?
records.en: I knew it... Is it interesting?

records.jp: もっとドロドロした展開が多い方がきらら好みだけど<CR>描写は生々しくて良い
records.en_original: I kind of wish it had more stuff about complicated relationships, but at least the pictures are nice and vivid.
records.en: Kirara would prefer more messy relationship drama, but the vivid depictions are good.

records.jp: とくに、男と人妻が押し入れの中で……
records.en_original: For example, there's this scene where one of the wives is in the closet with her man, and—
records.en: For example, there's this scene where one of the wives is in the closet with her man, and—

records.jp: もう、いい！　そこまでで、いいから！
records.en_original: Stop, stop! I don't want to hear anymore!
records.en: Stop, stop! I don't want to hear anymore!

records.jp: でも、きららの好きな本なら、<CR>読んでみよっかなー
records.en_original: Though if you recommended it, I would like to give it a try.
records.en: Though if you recommended it, I would like to give it a try.

records.jp: きららも、愛央の好きな本読みたい
records.en_original: I'd like to read your suggestions as well.
records.en: Kirara wants to read the books you like too, Ao.

records.jp: んじゃ、今日は読書会だ
records.en_original: Let's have a little book club today then!
records.en: Let's have a little book club today then!

records.jp: 賛成
records.en_original: Agreed.
records.en: Agreed.

records.jp: 愛央……これ、楽しい？
records.en_original: Ao... Are you enjoying yourself?
records.en: Ao... Are you enjoying yourself?

records.jp: ん？
records.en_original: What d'you mean?
records.en: What d'you mean?

records.jp: ただ、黙って本読んでるだけ。<CR>せっかく、愛央と二人でいるのに
records.en_original: Well, we're just reading in silence. Seems like we're wasting the time we're spending together.
records.en: Well, we're just reading in silence. Seems like we're wasting the time we're spending together.

records.jp: 私は楽しいよ！　お互いの好きな本を<CR>交換して読める友達ができてさ
records.en_original: I'm having fun! Nothing better than exchanging books with a friend and discussing your thoughts after finishing.
records.en: I'm having fun! Nothing better than exchanging books with a friend and discussing your thoughts after finishing.

records.jp: 友達……
records.en_original: A friend...
records.en: A friend...

records.jp: それに、話さなくたって<CR>隣にいるだけで、なんかうれしーってことない？
records.en_original: Plus, I'm just happy to be near you even if we're not talking. Don't you think so?
records.en: Plus, I'm just happy to be near you even if we're not talking. Don't you think so?

records.jp: ……うれしーってこと、ある
records.en_original: I do.
records.en: I do.

records.jp: でしょ！　今が、まさにそれだよ
records.en_original: Good! Glad we're on the same page.
records.en: Good! Glad we're on the same page.

records.jp: きららが話したいなら、いくらでも話すけど……<CR>どうする？
records.en_original: If you do wanna chat, I'm always up for it. Which do you prefer?
records.en: If you do wanna chat, I'm always up for it. Which do you prefer?

records.jp: このままでいい……<CR>一緒に、本読む
records.en_original: Let's keep going. I'd like to read some more.
records.en: Let's keep going. I'd like to read some more.

records.jp: きららは楽しい？
records.en_original: Are you having fun?
records.en: Are you having fun?

records.jp: ……楽しい、と思う
records.en_original: ...Yes. I am.
records.en: ...Yes. I am.

records.jp: なら、いーじゃん。私も楽しいし
records.en_original: Good! I'm having fun too.
records.en: Good! I'm having fun too.

records.jp: それは、その本が面白いから
records.en_original: That's just because you're enjoying the book.
records.en: That's just because you're enjoying the book.

records.jp: それもあるけど、きららと一緒にいるだけで<CR>楽しいっていうのもあるんですー
records.en_original: It's not just that. I like spending time with you, Kirara.
records.en: It's not just that. I like spending time with you, Kirara.

records.jp: きららだって、そうでしょ？
records.en_original: You feel the same, right Kirara?
records.en: You feel the same, right Kirara?

records.jp: きらら？
records.en_original: Kirara?
records.en: Kirara?

records.jp: 今、良いシーンだから、黙って
records.en_original: Shh. It's just getting good.
records.en: Shh. It's just getting good.

records.jp: ふふっ……はーい！
records.en_original: Hehe, you got it.
records.en: Hehe, you got it.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
